About us | Asset Management Switzerland AG Asset Management Switzerland is a proprietor-run company. Asset Management Switzerland offers active, independent wealth management, based on actively managed investment funds and ETFs and covering all asset classes. In March 2019, Dr. Torsten Dennin has been appointed Chief Investment Officer (CIO) at Asset Management Switzerland, and since then he is responsible for all investment decisions for clients and products of Asset Management Switzerland AG.
